name: Build: Anti-aliasing
body: Remove stair-stepped edges: MSAA first (simple, works with the current forward pass), TAA only if MSAA is too costly. One PR based on nox-proto, with before/after screenshots, a guide page and a decision.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Chose FXAA over MSAA/TAA (D-066). fxaa.frag, RecordAntiAlias, PostSettings.antiAliasingEnabled, SetAntiAliasing, guide docs/anti-aliasing.md. 203 of 203 tests on lavapipe. Metal and real-GPU timing unchecked.
